name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-10-20, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
